description: Append or replace one camera-view edit. Revises the selected looks using the named brief flow (default: all its looks); requires the current brief revision. Photo format is shared across the shoot. Returns a new brief and quote. No media generation, credit charge or library change. Read the returned recipe_key before the next edit.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

look_keys.description: Affected looks using this flow; omit for every look using it. Other looks retain their flow.

step_index.description: One-based dependent step to replace; omit to append. Each tool accepts only its own operation's settings.
